zh.title: 塞斯納母公司 Textron 擬以12億美元出售工業部門 聚焦航空與防務
zh.summary: 塞斯納與貝爾直升機的母公司 Textron 已同意以12億美元出售工業部門，預計於2027年上半年完成交易，之後將聚焦航空與防務業務。
body: Textron 11月18日宣布，已與 Kingswood Capital Management 的關係企業簽訂協議，以12億美元現金出售工業部門。這筆交易涵蓋 Kautex 與 Textron Specialized Vehicles，預計於2027年上半年完成，仍須取得監管核准並滿足其他交割條件。
交易完成後，Textron 將聚焦 Textron Aviation、Bell 與 Textron Systems 三項核心業務。Textron Aviation 旗下有塞斯納與比奇兩個飛機品牌，Bell 則生產軍用及商用旋翼機。
Textron 預計扣除稅款及交易相關費用後，將取得約11億美元淨現金。公司在交易公告中以「New Textron」稱呼出售後的航空與防務事業。

en.title: Cessna parent Textron to sell industrial unit for $1.2 billion and focus on aerospace
en.summary: Textron has agreed to sell its industrial segment for $1.2 billion. The deal is expected to close in the first half of 2027 and leave the Cessna and Bell parent focused on aerospace and defense.
body: Textron announced on November 18 that it had agreed to sell its industrial segment to an affiliate of Kingswood Capital Management for $1.2 billion in cash. The deal covers Kautex and Textron Specialized Vehicles and is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to regulatory approvals and other closing conditions.

After the sale, Textron will focus on Textron Aviation, Bell and Textron Systems. Textron Aviation includes the Cessna and Beechcraft aircraft brands. Bell produces military and commercial rotorcraft.
Textron expects to receive about $1.1 billion in net cash after taxes and transaction costs. The company refers to the aerospace and defense business that will remain after closing as “New Textron.”
